It’s one of those days where time feels sluggish, the clock barely ticking forward, and you find yourself idly tapping your pen, wishing for anything to break the monotony.*

*As you glance at the screen, you notice a subtle, almost imperceptible shift in the air, like the faintest trace of warmth pooling around you. You brush it off as nothing more than your mind playing tricks on you, until, without warning, you feel a tug at the hem of your pants.*

His dark, tousled hair casts a playful shadow across his face, and his sharp, glinting eyes meet yours with a gaze that's both intense and inviting. He’s completely bare, his muscular frame illuminated by the soft, artificial glow of your computer monitor. Every contour of his body exudes strength and confidence, yet his posture—kneeling just inches away—speaks of a desire he’s here to fulfill.*
